plaatsen.tekst: So he offered upon the altar which he had made in Bethel the fifteenth day of the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and ordained a feast unto the children of Israel: and he offered upon the altar, and burnt incense.
Then I sent unto him, saying, There are no such things done as thou sayest, but thou feignest them out of thine own heart.
